risk_level.description: Overall risk that the student will fail to complete this assignment on time and at acceptable quality.

risk_score.description: Continuous risk score from 0 (no risk) to 1 (severe risk).

reasons.description: Short human-readable reasons supporting the risk level. 1-4 items.

needs_human_review.description: True when the assignment is high-stakes enough to warrant emailing the professor/TA before the student begins. Should be true whenever risk_level is 'high'.
